name: Proofpoint - High Volume of Blocked Emails from a Single IP
xql_query:
dataset = proofpoint_tap_raw
| filter _log_type = "message-blocked" and senderIP in (
    dataset = proofpoint_tap_raw
    | filter _log_type = "message-blocked"
    | comp count(GUID) as email_count by senderIP
    | filter email_count >= 5
    | fields senderIP
)
| fields *
description: Returns individual blocked emails whose sender IP is responsible for a high volume (>=5) of blocked malicious emails - indicative of a bulk malicious campaign from that source.
alert_name: Proofpoint - High Volume of Blocked Emails from a Single IP
alert_description:
What fired: this email was blocked and its sender IP is among those sending a high volume (>=5) of blocked malicious emails in the window - a bulk/campaign source.

Why it matters: concentrated malicious sending from one IP indicates an active campaign against the organization.

Investigate:
  - Review the mapped sender IP, recipient, subject and threat details.
  - Pivot on the sender IP to see the full set of targeted recipients and whether any message from it was DELIVERED (not blocked).
  - Consider blocking the sender IP/domain.

MITRE ATT&CK: T1566 - Phishing (TA0001 - Initial Access).
